title: DynamicAnimation (Automate & Greatly Enhance Battle Animations) [RPG Maker MV Plugin]

blocks.source: DynamicAnimation（戦闘アニメを自動化＆超強化）【RPGツクールMVプラグイン】
blocks.translation: DynamicAnimation (Automate & Greatly Enhance Battle Animations) [RPG Maker MV Plugin]

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメを自動化＆超強化するプラグインです。
blocks.translation: This plugin automates and greatly enhances battle animations.

blocks.source: Click here for the English manual.（By Ryan Bram）
blocks.translation: Click here for the English manual. (By Ryan Bram)

blocks.source: スキル（アイテム）から自在に戦闘アニメーションを呼び出せます。異なるＩＤのアニメーションを同時表示させたり、移動させたりすることが可能です。
blocks.translation: You can freely call battle animations from skills (items). You can display animations with different IDs simultaneously or move them.

blocks.source: 非常に自由度の高い仕様になっていますが、テンプレートを呼び出せばメモ欄に一行記述（例：<D-Animation:shot/>）するだけでも動作します。
blocks.translation: Although it offers a high degree of freedom, you can also make it work simply by calling a template and entering a single line in the note field (e.g., <D-Animation:shot/>).

blocks.translation: The following is an introduction video.

blocks.source: 更新履歴
blocks.translation: Update History

blocks.source: 意図しない競合を引き起こす不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused unintended conflicts.

blocks.source: マップ版DynamicAnimationにて戦闘時の並列アニメを使用した場合、不正なデータ状態になってエラー落ちしてしまうなど。
blocks.translation: For example, using parallel animations during battles with the map version of DynamicAnimation could result in an invalid data state and cause an error crash.

blocks.source: ※DynamicMotionも同時に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please update DynamicMotion at the same time.

blocks.source: 影プラグインと併用すると、敵の影が表示されなくなる不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused enemy shadows to disappear when used with the Shadow plugin.

blocks.source: 放物線（ジャンプ）の最初の１フレームで宙に浮いていない不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where the character was not floating in the air during the first frame of a parabola (jump).

blocks.source: 放物線（ジャンプ）の到達後にアニメーションが下に移動してしまう不具合修正。（2023/10/18 ver1.271）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where the animation moved downward after reaching the destination of a parabola (jump). (2023/10/18 ver1.271)

blocks.source: ※NRP_DynamicMotionも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update NRP_DynamicMotion to the latest version.

blocks.source: condition指定時、タイミング制御が不安定になる不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused timing control to become unstable when condition was specified.

blocks.source: playSeの後ろに注釈（//）を記述するとエラーになる不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused an error when a comment (//) was written after playSe.

blocks.source: ※NRP_DynamicMotionも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update NRP_DynamicMotion to the latest version.

blocks.source: 動作対象を変更した場合、ミラーリングが逆方向に動作する不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where mirroring operated in the opposite direction when the target was changed.

blocks.source: ※DynamicMotion側の修正です。
blocks.translation: ※This is a fix on the DynamicMotion side.

blocks.source: 他プラグインとの競合によるエラーを軽減。（12/24 ver1.251）
blocks.translation: Reduced errors caused by conflicts with other plugins. (12/24 ver1.251)

blocks.source: ※NRP_DynamicAnimationMap.jsも修正しています。
blocks.translation: ※NRP_DynamicAnimationMap.js has also been fixed.

blocks.source: condition指定時、条件を満たさなかった場合でもウェイトがかかってしまう不具合を修正。（2022/03/10 ver1.252）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where a wait was applied even when the conditions were not met when condition was specified. (2022/03/10 ver1.252)

blocks.source: マップ版DynamicAnimationの『途中から再生』に対応。
blocks.translation: Added support for "Play from Middle" in the map version of DynamicAnimation.

blocks.source: ※各関連プラグインも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update all related plugins to the latest versions.

blocks.source: 一つのアニメーションが消滅するまでに、プレイヤーがマップ全体の半分以上を移動するとアニメーションの表示が消える不具合修正。（04/28 ver1.241）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where an animation disappeared if the player moved more than halfway across the entire map before the animation disappeared. (04/28 ver1.241)

blocks.source: delay=0の場合、残像機能が動作しない不具合修正。（06/16 ver1.242）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where the afterimage feature did not work when delay=0. (06/16 ver1.242)

blocks.source: ※Motion側にあった機能をAnimation側にも追加しました。
blocks.translation: ※Added a feature that was available on the Motion side to the Animation side as well.

blocks.source: アニメーションの位置計算時、対象の拡大率（scale）を参照するように修正。
blocks.translation: Adjusted the position calculation of animations to reference the target's scale.

blocks.source: DynamicMotionをオンにしないとエラーになる不具合修正。（11/26 ver1.221）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused an error unless DynamicMotion was turned on. (11/26 ver1.221)

blocks.source: VE系プラグインと関数名がかぶっていたので調整。（11/26 ver1.221）
blocks.translation: Adjusted the function names because they overlapped with those of VE plugins. (11/26 ver1.221)

blocks.source: ※DynamicMotionも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update DynamicMotion to the latest version.

blocks.source: マップ版DynamicAnimationにて、画面スクロール時に一瞬だけアニメーションの位置がズレる不具合修正。（2021/04/14 ver1.222）
blocks.translation: For the map version of DynamicAnimation, fixed a bug where the animation position shifted briefly when the screen scrolled. (2021/04/14 ver1.222)

blocks.source: テンプレート一覧の表示情報を整理。テンプレートＩＤが収まるように調整。
blocks.translation: Reorganized the information displayed in the template list. Adjusted it so that the template ID fits.

blocks.source: ※各関連プラグインも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update all related plugins to the latest versions.

blocks.source: 色調変更すると合成方法が一瞬『通常』になる不具合修正（11/10 ver1.211）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where changing the tone briefly changed the blend mode to "Normal" (11/10 ver1.211)

blocks.source: ※テンプレートの追加・修正はプラグインを再登録しないと反映されません。
blocks.translation: ※Adding or modifying templates will not take effect unless the plugin is registered again.

blocks.source: ただし、再登録すると全ての設定変更が初期化されてしまいます。
blocks.translation: However, registering it again resets all setting changes.

blocks.source: 外部プラグインとの連携用に調整。
blocks.translation: Adjusted it for integration with external plugins.

blocks.source: マップ版DynamicAnimationにて、アニメーションの位置が『画面』の場合もスクロールの影響を受けるように修正。
blocks.translation: For the map version of DynamicAnimation, adjusted it so that animations are affected by scrolling even when their position is set to "Screen".

blocks.source: ※各関連プラグインも最新に更新してください。
blocks.translation: ※Please also update all related plugins to the latest versions.

blocks.source: マップ版にて複数の命令を組み合わせた場合、不要なウェイトが発生する不具合を修正。および処理軽量化。
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug that caused unnecessary waits when multiple commands were combined in the map version. Also reduced processing load.

blocks.source: マップ版にて戦闘時に使用すると、セーブに保存できなくなったり、次回の戦闘開始時にエラーになったりする不具合修正。（10/20 ver1.181）
blocks.translation: For the map version, fixed a bug where using it during battle prevented saving to save data or caused an error when the next battle began. (10/20 ver1.181)

blocks.source: アニメーションの頭上表示が反映されない不具合修正。（10/29 ver1.182）
blocks.translation: Fixed a bug where displaying an animation above the target did not take effect. (10/29 ver1.182)

blocks.source: 実行条件（condition）をリピート項目に変更。
blocks.translation: Changed the execution condition (condition) to a repeat item.

blocks.source: 例：『condition = b.isStateAffected(10)』で睡眠中の対象のみアニメ表示。
blocks.translation: Example: With "condition = b.isStateAffected(10)", the animation is displayed only for targets affected by Sleep.

blocks.source: 範囲がなしの場合に対象を取得できずエラーとなる不具合修正。（自身をデフォルトの対象としています。）（09/27 ver1.131）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where an error occurred because the target could not be obtained when no range was specified. (Self is used as the default target.) (09/27 ver1.131)

blocks.source: 『参照先バトラー(a, b)』の初期値を『1:Game_Battler』に変更した。
blocks.translation: Changed the default value of “Referenced Battler (a, b)” to “1:Game_Battler”.

blocks.source: 今後『a._battler.atk』のような参照は推奨しません。（『a.atk』に統一）
blocks.translation: References such as “a._battler.atk” are no longer recommended. (Use “a.atk” consistently.)

blocks.source: 他プラグインとの競合軽減のため微調整。（09/10 ver1.121）
blocks.translation: Minor adjustments to reduce conflicts with other plugins. (09/10 ver1.121)

blocks.source: 設定した数値によって、ランダム座標のアニメをそれっぽくバラつかせます。
blocks.translation: Adds natural variation to the random-coordinate animation based on the configured values.

blocks.source: 外部プラグインからアニメを割り込ませた場合、再生が遅れる問題に対応。
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where playback was delayed when an animation was inserted by an external plugin.

blocks.source: ダメージ型テンプレートが反映されていない不具合を修正。（ver1.111）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where damage-type templates were not applied. (ver1.111)

blocks.source: 例：『plugin = hoge 100 200』という感じで呼び出せます。
blocks.translation: For example, you can call it like this: “plugin = hoge 100 200”.

blocks.source: ランダム座標のアニメで残像が正しく表示されない不具合修正。（ver1.101）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where afterimages were not displayed correctly in random-coordinate animations. (ver1.101)

blocks.source: それに伴い『水平（horizontal）』『貫通（pierce）』『魔法発動（spell）』型のテンプレートを修正。
blocks.translation: Accordingly, the templates for the “Horizontal (horizontal),” “Pierce (pierce),” and “Spell (spell)” types were modified.

blocks.source: ※互換性があるため反映しなくとも動作上の差は出ません。(ver1.092で調整)
blocks.translation: ※Because they are compatible, there is no functional difference even if this is not applied. (Adjusted in ver1.092)

blocks.source: また『貫通（pierce）』型テンプレートで複数対象の際に複数アニメーションが表示される不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: Also fixed an issue where multiple animations were displayed for multiple targets with the “Pierce (pierce)” type template.

blocks.source: アニメーションの終了に合わせてダメージ処理を実施してくれます。
blocks.translation: Damage processing is performed when the animation ends.

blocks.source: 指定が<D-Motion>のみの場合、フリーズする不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the game froze when only <D-Motion> was specified.

blocks.source: 開発中のダメージ一括表示プラグイン用に調整。（ver1.093）
blocks.translation: Adjusted for the damage batch display plugin currently in development. (ver1.093)

blocks.source: 『damage=false』を指定した際にもダメージ処理がされてしまう不具合修正。（ver1.095）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where damage processing was still performed when “damage=false” was specified. (ver1.095)

blocks.source: 不要なデバッグ用処理を削除。（ver1.096）
blocks.translation: Removed unnecessary debugging processes. (ver1.096)

blocks.source: 参照先バトラーの互換機能でindexが取得できない不具合修正。（ver1.096）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the index could not be obtained through the referenced battler compatibility feature. (ver1.096)

blocks.source: 大量アニメーションの動作を大幅軽量化。
blocks.translation: Significantly reduced the processing load of large numbers of animations.

blocks.source: 継続（keep）型テンプレートの定義修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed the definition of the Continuous (keep) type template.

blocks.source: delay値は最初のアニメーションの終点に合わせるようにした。
blocks.translation: The delay value is now matched to the endpoint of the first animation.

blocks.source: 複数対象時の不要処理を削除して軽量化した。
blocks.translation: Removed unnecessary processing for multiple targets to reduce the processing load.

blocks.source: 効果音を先読みして遅延を減らすようにした。
blocks.translation: Sound effects are now preloaded to reduce delays.

blocks.source: 戦闘不能対象に空振りでエラーとなる不具合修正。（04/24 ver1.061）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where a miss against a battle-incapacitated target resulted in an error. (04/24 ver1.061)

blocks.source: animationBaseDelayが0だと再生されない不具合修正。（04/26 ver1.062）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where playback did not occur when animationBaseDelay was 0. (04/26 ver1.062)

blocks.source: <D-Animation:shot/>→<da:shot/>みたいに書けます。
blocks.translation: You can write it like <D-Animation:shot/>→<da:shot/>.

blocks.source: →4/11 アクターにフラッシュがかからない不具合があったため修正しました！
blocks.translation: →4/11 Fixed an issue where actors did not flash!

blocks.source: 『水平（horizontal）』『水平射撃（shotHorizontal）』『垂直（vertical）』テンプレートのアニメ表示位置の誤りを修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed incorrect animation display positions in the “Horizontal (horizontal),” “Horizontal Shot (shotHorizontal),” and “Vertical (vertical)” templates.

blocks.source: ↑に伴い貫通（pierce）型テンプレートの角度変更を削除。
blocks.translation: As a result, the angle change was removed from the Pierce (pierce) type template.

blocks.source: 『通常攻撃』のアニメーションが表示されない不具合修正。（ver1.041）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the “Normal Attack” animation was not displayed. (ver1.041)

blocks.source: 開発中のモーションプラグインとの連携機能をさらに追加。
blocks.translation: Added further integration features with the motion plugin currently in development.

blocks.source: delay=auto時に前回のウェイトを無視する不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the previous wait was ignored when delay=auto.

blocks.source: 対象ごとの時間差（delay）の値をアニメーションフレーム単位に修正。
blocks.translation: Changed the delay value between targets to use animation frames as its unit.

blocks.source: ウェイト（wait）型、ディレイ（delay）型のテンプレートを追加。
blocks.translation: Added Wait (wait) and Delay (delay) type templates.

blocks.source: shot, shotRandom, arc, arcRandom, horizontal, shotHorizontal, vertical, pierce, spell, followの各テンプレートについて、アニメーションに設定された『位置』を参照するように修正。
blocks.translation: Modified the shot, shotRandom, arc, arcRandom, horizontal, shotHorizontal, vertical, pierce, spell, and follow templates to reference the “Position” set for the animation.

blocks.source: follow型の定義再修正
blocks.translation: Revised the definition of the follow type

blocks.source: 自分（self）型のテンプレートを追加。（ver1.031）
blocks.translation: Added a Self (self) type template. (ver1.031)

blocks.source: noMirror属性が機能しない不具合修正。（ver1.032）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the noMirror attribute did not work. (ver1.032)

blocks.source: 『Ｙ座標の反転後調整』『dx』『dy』のパラメータが機能しない不具合修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where the “Adjustment After Y-Coordinate Inversion,” “dx,” and “dy” parameters did not work.

blocks.source: アニメーション同士をつなぐタイミングを微調整。
blocks.translation: Fine-tuned the timing for connecting animations.

blocks.source: ウェイトが過剰にかかる不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where excessive waits were applied.

blocks.source: 開発中のモーションプラグインとの連携処理を実装。
blocks.translation: Implemented integration with the motion plugin currently in development.

blocks.source: ツクールMV1.5.Xでも動作するよう対応。
blocks.translation: Made it compatible with RPG Maker MV 1.5.X.

blocks.source: 公開！
blocks.translation: Released!

blocks.source: 一部の数式でエラーとなる不具合修正。（ver1.001 02/22）
blocks.translation: Fixed an issue where certain formulas caused errors. (ver1.001 02/22)

blocks.source: 使用方法
blocks.translation: How to Use

blocks.source: スキル（アイテム）のメモ欄からテンプレートを呼び出すことでアニメーションの動作が変化します。以下は射撃（shot）型のテンプレートを呼び出した例です。
blocks.translation: Calling a template from the note field of a skill (item) changes how its animation behaves. The following is an example that calls a Shot (shot) type template.

blocks.source: さらにテンプレートに対して、パラメータの追加・上書が可能です。
blocks.translation: You can also add or overwrite parameters in the template.

blocks.source: repeat = 5 // 繰返し回数
blocks.translation: repeat = 5 // Number of repetitions

blocks.source: 最低限の使用法は上記の通りですが、パラメータは非常に多くあります。
blocks.translation: The basic usage is described above, but there are many parameters available.

blocks.source: まずは以下の『基本的な使用法』のページから見ると分かりやすいでしょう。
blocks.translation: It may be easiest to start with the following “Basic Usage” page.

blocks.source: その後、『テンプレートの解説』や『プラグインパラメータ一覧』を参照していくのがオススメです。
blocks.translation: After that, I recommend referring to “Template Guide” and “Plugin Parameter List”.

blocks.translation: Arc (arc), Random Arc (arcRandom), All Random Arc (arcRandomAll)

blocks.translation: Random (random), All Random (randomAll)

blocks.translation: Pierce (pierce)

blocks.translation: Follow (follow), Self (self), Wait (wait), Delay (delay)

blocks.translation: Damage (damage), In Battle (ifBattle), On Map (ifMap)

blocks.source: その他情報
blocks.translation: Other Information

blocks.source: 競合について
blocks.translation: Compatibility Issues

blocks.source: 『YEP_CoreEngine.js』と共用する場合、NRP_DynamicAnimation.jsのほうを下に配置してください。同一の関数を上書きしているため、そうしないと動きません。
blocks.translation: When using it together with “YEP_CoreEngine.js,” place NRP_DynamicAnimation.js below it. Since they overwrite the same function, it will not work otherwise.

blocks.source: YEP_BattleEngineCore v1.50でそれなりに安定していることを確認しています。ＭＶの公式からＤＬできる古いバージョンだと、背景が消し飛んだりと挙動が怪しいです。
blocks.translation: I have confirmed that it is reasonably stable with YEP_BattleEngineCore v1.50. With the old version available for download from the official MV site, its behavior is unreliable, such as the background disappearing.

blocks.source: 『MOG_BattleHud.js』と共用する場合は、MOG側を下に配置してください。そうしないとアクターが対象のアニメーションが動作しません。
blocks.translation: When using it together with “MOG_BattleHud.js,” place the MOG plugin below it. Otherwise, animations targeting actors will not work.

blocks.source: ソースを触れる人なら『_alias_mog_bhud_sprt_actor_setupAnimation.call(this);』とある行を『Sprite_Battler.prototype.setupAnimation.call(this);』に修正してもＯＫです。これなら順番は影響しないはず……。
blocks.translation: If you are comfortable modifying the source, you can also change the line containing “_alias_mog_bhud_sprt_actor_setupAnimation.call(this);” to “Sprite_Battler.prototype.setupAnimation.call(this);”. In that case, the order should not matter...

texts.戦闘アニメを自動化＆超強化するプラグインです。: This plugin automates and greatly enhances battle animations.
texts.Click here for the English manual.（By Ry: Click here for the English manual. (By Ryan Bram)
texts.スキル（アイテム）から自在に戦闘アニメーションを呼び出せます。異なるＩＤのアニメ: You can freely call battle animations from skills (items). You can display animations with different IDs simultaneously or move them.
texts.非常に自由度の高い仕様になっていますが、テンプレートを呼び出せばメモ欄に一行記述: Although it offers a high degree of freedom, you can also make it work simply by calling a template and entering a single line in the note field (e.g., <D-Animation:shot/>).
texts.以下は紹介動画です。: The following is an introduction video.
texts.このブラウザでは再生できません。: This video cannot be played in this browser.
texts.以下のファイルをダウンロードし 、[プロジェクト]\\js\\plugins に: Download the following file and place it in [Project]\js\plugins. Turn the feature ON from RPG Maker MV's Plugin Manager.
texts.※プラグイン同士の配置順に注意してください。上記の掲載順にそのまま配置すれば安全: ※Pay attention to the order in which the plugins are placed. It is safe to place them in the order listed above.
texts.意図しない競合を引き起こす不具合を修正。: Fixed a bug that caused unintended conflicts.
texts.マップ版DynamicAnimationにて戦闘時の並列アニメを使用した場合、不: For example, using parallel animations during battles with the map version of DynamicAnimation could result in an invalid data state and cause an error crash.
texts.※DynamicMotionも同時に更新してください。: ※Please update DynamicMotion at the same time.
texts.影プラグインと併用すると、敵の影が表示されなくなる不具合修正。: Fixed a bug that caused enemy shadows to disappear when used with the Shadow plugin.
texts.放物線（ジャンプ）の最初の１フレームで宙に浮いていない不具合修正。: Fixed a bug where the character was not floating in the air during the first frame of a parabola (jump).
texts.放物線（ジャンプ）の到達後にアニメーションが下に移動してしまう不具合修正。（20: Fixed a bug where the animation moved downward after reaching the destination of a parabola (jump). (2023/10/18 ver1.271)
texts.※NRP_DynamicMotionも最新に更新してください。: ※Please also update NRP_DynamicMotion to the latest version.
texts.condition指定時、タイミング制御が不安定になる不具合修正。: Fixed a bug that caused timing control to become unstable when condition was specified.
texts.playSeの後ろに注釈（//）を記述するとエラーになる不具合修正。: Fixed a bug that caused an error when a comment (//) was written after playSe.
texts.動作対象を変更した場合、ミラーリングが逆方向に動作する不具合修正。: Fixed a bug where mirroring operated in the opposite direction when the target was changed.
texts.※DynamicMotion側の修正です。: ※This is a fix on the DynamicMotion side.
texts.他プラグインとの競合によるエラーを軽減。（12/24 ver1.251）: Reduced errors caused by conflicts with other plugins. (12/24 ver1.251)
texts.condition指定時、条件を満たさなかった場合でもウェイトがかかってしまう不: Fixed a bug where a wait was applied even when the conditions were not met when condition was specified. (2022/03/10 ver1.252)
texts.マップ版DynamicAnimationの『途中から再生』に対応。: Added support for "Play from Middle" in the map version of DynamicAnimation.
texts.※各関連プラグインも最新に更新してください。: ※Please also update all related plugins to the latest versions.
texts.一つのアニメーションが消滅するまでに、プレイヤーがマップ全体の半分以上を移動する: Fixed a bug where an animation disappeared if the player moved more than halfway across the entire map before the animation disappeared. (04/28 ver1.241)
texts.delay=0の場合、残像機能が動作しない不具合修正。（06/16 ver1.2: Fixed a bug where the afterimage feature did not work when delay=0. (06/16 ver1.242)
texts.※Motion側にあった機能をAnimation側にも追加しました。: ※Added a feature that was available on the Motion side to the Animation side as well.
texts.アニメーションの位置計算時、対象の拡大率（scale）を参照するように修正。: Adjusted the position calculation of animations to reference the target's scale.
texts.DynamicMotionをオンにしないとエラーになる不具合修正。（11/26: Fixed a bug that caused an error unless DynamicMotion was turned on. (11/26 ver1.221)
texts.VE系プラグインと関数名がかぶっていたので調整。（11/26 ver1.221）: Adjusted the function names because they overlapped with those of VE plugins. (11/26 ver1.221)
texts.※DynamicMotionも最新に更新してください。: ※Please also update DynamicMotion to the latest version.
texts.マップ版DynamicAnimationにて、画面スクロール時に一瞬だけアニメー: For the map version of DynamicAnimation, fixed a bug where the animation position shifted briefly when the screen scrolled. (2021/04/14 ver1.222)
texts.テンプレート一覧の表示情報を整理。テンプレートＩＤが収まるように調整。: Reorganized the information displayed in the template list. Adjusted it so that the template ID fits.
texts.色調変更すると合成方法が一瞬『通常』になる不具合修正（11/10 ver1.21: Fixed a bug where changing the tone briefly changed the blend mode to "Normal" (11/10 ver1.211)
texts.※テンプレートの追加・修正はプラグインを再登録しないと反映されません。: ※Adding or modifying templates will not take effect unless the plugin is registered again.
texts.ただし、再登録すると全ての設定変更が初期化されてしまいます。: However, registering it again resets all setting changes.
texts.外部プラグインとの連携用に調整。: Adjusted it for integration with external plugins.
texts.マップ版DynamicAnimationにて、アニメーションの位置が『画面』の場: For the map version of DynamicAnimation, adjusted it so that animations are affected by scrolling even when their position is set to "Screen".
texts.マップ版にて複数の命令を組み合わせた場合、不要なウェイトが発生する不具合を修正。: Fixed a bug that caused unnecessary waits when multiple commands were combined in the map version. Also reduced processing load.
texts.マップ版にて戦闘時に使用すると、セーブに保存できなくなったり、次回の戦闘開始時に: For the map version, fixed a bug where using it during battle prevented saving to save data or caused an error when the next battle began. (10/20 ver1.181)
texts.アニメーションの頭上表示が反映されない不具合修正。（10/29 ver1.182: Fixed a bug where displaying an animation above the target did not take effect. (10/29 ver1.182)
texts.実行条件（condition）をリピート項目に変更。: Changed the execution condition (condition) to a repeat item.
texts.例：『condition = b.isStateAffected(10)』で睡眠: Example: With "condition = b.isStateAffected(10)", the animation is displayed only for targets affected by Sleep.
texts.範囲がなしの場合に対象を取得できずエラーとなる不具合修正。（自身をデフォルトの対: Fixed an issue where an error occurred because the target could not be obtained when no range was specified. (Self is used as the default target.) (09/27 ver1.131)
texts.『参照先バトラー(a, b)』の初期値を『1:Game_Battler』に変更し: Changed the default value of “Referenced Battler (a, b)” to “1:Game_Battler”.
texts.今後『a._battler.atk』のような参照は推奨しません。（『a.atk』: References such as “a._battler.atk” are no longer recommended. (Use “a.atk” consistently.)
texts.他プラグインとの競合軽減のため微調整。（09/10 ver1.121）: Minor adjustments to reduce conflicts with other plugins. (09/10 ver1.121)
texts.設定した数値によって、ランダム座標のアニメをそれっぽくバラつかせます。: Adds natural variation to the random-coordinate animation based on the configured values.
texts.外部プラグインからアニメを割り込ませた場合、再生が遅れる問題に対応。: Fixed an issue where playback was delayed when an animation was inserted by an external plugin.
texts.ダメージ型テンプレートが反映されていない不具合を修正。（ver1.111）: Fixed an issue where damage-type templates were not applied. (ver1.111)
texts.例：『plugin = hoge 100 200』という感じで呼び出せます。: For example, you can call it like this: “plugin = hoge 100 200”.
texts.ランダム座標のアニメで残像が正しく表示されない不具合修正。（ver1.101）: Fixed an issue where afterimages were not displayed correctly in random-coordinate animations. (ver1.101)
texts.それに伴い『水平（horizontal）』『貫通（pierce）』『魔法発動（s: Accordingly, the templates for the “Horizontal (horizontal),” “Pierce (pierce),” and “Spell (spell)” types were modified.
texts.※互換性があるため反映しなくとも動作上の差は出ません。(ver1.092で調整): ※Because they are compatible, there is no functional difference even if this is not applied. (Adjusted in ver1.092)
texts.また『貫通（pierce）』型テンプレートで複数対象の際に複数アニメーションが表: Also fixed an issue where multiple animations were displayed for multiple targets with the “Pierce (pierce)” type template.
texts.アニメーションの終了に合わせてダメージ処理を実施してくれます。: Damage processing is performed when the animation ends.
texts.指定が<D-Motion>のみの場合、フリーズする不具合修正。: Fixed an issue where the game froze when only <D-Motion> was specified.
texts.開発中のダメージ一括表示プラグイン用に調整。（ver1.093）: Adjusted for the damage batch display plugin currently in development. (ver1.093)
texts.『damage=false』を指定した際にもダメージ処理がされてしまう不具合修正: Fixed an issue where damage processing was still performed when “damage=false” was specified. (ver1.095)
texts.参照先バトラーの互換機能でindexが取得できない不具合修正。（ver1.096: Fixed an issue where the index could not be obtained through the referenced battler compatibility feature. (ver1.096)
texts.大量アニメーションの動作を大幅軽量化。: Significantly reduced the processing load of large numbers of animations.
texts.継続（keep）型テンプレートの定義修正。: Fixed the definition of the Continuous (keep) type template.
texts.delay値は最初のアニメーションの終点に合わせるようにした。: The delay value is now matched to the endpoint of the first animation.
texts.複数対象時の不要処理を削除して軽量化した。: Removed unnecessary processing for multiple targets to reduce the processing load.
texts.効果音を先読みして遅延を減らすようにした。: Sound effects are now preloaded to reduce delays.
texts.戦闘不能対象に空振りでエラーとなる不具合修正。（04/24 ver1.061）: Fixed an issue where a miss against a battle-incapacitated target resulted in an error. (04/24 ver1.061)
texts.animationBaseDelayが0だと再生されない不具合修正。（04/26: Fixed an issue where playback did not occur when animationBaseDelay was 0. (04/26 ver1.062)
texts.→4/11 アクターにフラッシュがかからない不具合があったため修正しました！: →4/11 Fixed an issue where actors did not flash!
texts.『水平（horizontal）』『水平射撃（shotHorizontal）』『垂: Fixed incorrect animation display positions in the “Horizontal (horizontal),” “Horizontal Shot (shotHorizontal),” and “Vertical (vertical)” templates.
texts.↑に伴い貫通（pierce）型テンプレートの角度変更を削除。: As a result, the angle change was removed from the Pierce (pierce) type template.
texts.『通常攻撃』のアニメーションが表示されない不具合修正。（ver1.041）: Fixed an issue where the “Normal Attack” animation was not displayed. (ver1.041)
texts.開発中のモーションプラグインとの連携機能をさらに追加。: Added further integration features with the motion plugin currently in development.
texts.delay=auto時に前回のウェイトを無視する不具合修正。: Fixed an issue where the previous wait was ignored when delay=auto.
texts.対象ごとの時間差（delay）の値をアニメーションフレーム単位に修正。: Changed the delay value between targets to use animation frames as its unit.
texts.ウェイト（wait）型、ディレイ（delay）型のテンプレートを追加。: Added Wait (wait) and Delay (delay) type templates.
texts.shot, shotRandom, arc, arcRandom, horizo: Modified the shot, shotRandom, arc, arcRandom, horizontal, shotHorizontal, vertical, pierce, spell, and follow templates to reference the “Position” set for the animation.
texts.follow型の定義再修正: Revised the definition of the follow type
texts.noMirror属性が機能しない不具合修正。（ver1.032）: Fixed an issue where the noMirror attribute did not work. (ver1.032)
texts.『Ｙ座標の反転後調整』『dx』『dy』のパラメータが機能しない不具合修正。: Fixed an issue where the “Adjustment After Y-Coordinate Inversion,” “dx,” and “dy” parameters did not work.
texts.アニメーション同士をつなぐタイミングを微調整。: Fine-tuned the timing for connecting animations.
texts.ウェイトが過剰にかかる不具合を修正。: Fixed an issue where excessive waits were applied.
texts.開発中のモーションプラグインとの連携処理を実装。: Implemented integration with the motion plugin currently in development.
texts.ツクールMV1.5.Xでも動作するよう対応。: Made it compatible with RPG Maker MV 1.5.X.
texts.一部の数式でエラーとなる不具合修正。（ver1.001 02/22）: Fixed an issue where certain formulas caused errors. (ver1.001 02/22)
texts.スキル（アイテム）のメモ欄からテンプレートを呼び出すことでアニメーションの動作が: Calling a template from the note field of a skill (item) changes how its animation behaves. The following is an example that calls a Shot (shot) type template.
texts.さらにテンプレートに対して、パラメータの追加・上書が可能です。: You can also add or overwrite parameters in the template.
texts.最低限の使用法は上記の通りですが、パラメータは非常に多くあります。: The basic usage is described above, but there are many parameters available.
texts.まずは以下の『基本的な使用法』のページから見ると分かりやすいでしょう。: It may be easiest to start with the following “Basic Usage” page.
texts.その後、『テンプレートの解説』や『プラグインパラメータ一覧』を参照していくのがオ: After that, I recommend referring to “Template Guide” and “Plugin Parameter List”.
texts.射撃（shot）、乱射（shotRandom）、全乱射（shotRandomAl: Shot (shot), Random Shot (shotRandom), All Random Shot (shotRandomAll)
texts.投射（arc）、乱投射（arcRandom）、全乱投射（arcRandomAll: Arc (arc), Random Arc (arcRandom), All Random Arc (arcRandomAll)
texts.移動渦（moveVortex）、発散移動渦（spreadMoveVortex）、: Moving Vortex (moveVortex), Spread Moving Vortex (spreadMoveVortex), Breath (breath)
texts.進路を向く（lookCourse）、回転（roll）、画面（screen）、頭上: Face the Course (lookCourse), Roll (roll), Screen (screen), Head (head)
texts.『YEP_CoreEngine.js』と共用する場合、NRP_DynamicAn: When using it together with “YEP_CoreEngine.js,” place NRP_DynamicAnimation.js below it. Since they overwrite the same function, it will not work otherwise.
texts.YEP_BattleEngineCore v1.50でそれなりに安定していること: I have confirmed that it is reasonably stable with YEP_BattleEngineCore v1.50. With the old version available for download from the official MV site, its behavior is unreliable, such as the background disappearing.
texts.『MOG_BattleHud.js』と共用する場合は、MOG側を下に配置してくだ: When using it together with “MOG_BattleHud.js,” place the MOG plugin below it. Otherwise, animations targeting actors will not work.
texts.ソースを触れる人なら『_alias_mog_bhud_sprt_actor_se: If you are comfortable modifying the source, you can also change the line containing “_alias_mog_bhud_sprt_actor_setupAnimation.call(this);” to “Sprite_Battler.prototype.setupAnimation.call(this);”. In that case, the order should not matter...
texts.非サイドビューの場合は同じくMOG_BattleHud側の『Sprite_Act: For non-side-view battles, it may also be necessary to delete “Sprite_Actor.prototype.setupAnimation” entirely from MOG_BattleHud for it to work. (Untested)
